application.executiveSummary: House of Jazzu is developing NIA Capital OS, an AI-powered business operating platform that helps organizations discover funding opportunities, automate workflows, and accelerate growth.
application.innovation: An intelligent capital operating system combining AI automation, opportunity discovery, business intelligence, and execution workflows.
application.problem: Small businesses and innovators struggle to identify, prepare, and manage funding opportunities efficiently.
application.solution: NIA provides an AI-driven workflow for finding capital opportunities, preparing applications, and managing execution.
application.impact: Reduce barriers to capital access and improve startup growth outcomes.
